Packed/bitmap data, NOT code (region verified 0 prologues / 0 jr ra). Dominant filler word is 0x02020202 appearing in long runs (e.g. 0x184070..0x184088, 0x1842F0..0x184308). These filler runs are punctuated by short 'active' runs of low bytes 0x10-0x78 introduced/closed by 0x78 marker bytes -- signature of an RLE/scanline-packed graphic or font bitmap. Representative active words: 0x02027877 @0x184004, 0x78775675 @0x184008, 0x362C6B69 @0x184048, 0x6969352C @0x18404C, 0x40404043 @0x184024. Note repeated 0x6B/0x69/0x6A/0x2C/0x36/0x40/0x42/0x5A/0x59/0x71/0x72/0x78 byte alphabet -- consistent with a small dictionary of packed symbols, not ASCII text. HYPOTHESIS: compressed/packed art or tile data; not parsed.

Continuation of the same 0x02-filler-plus-0x78-bracketed-run packed pattern. Around 0x1848A0..0x1848D0 are the printable-ASCII-looking byte runs called out as SPECIAL: 0x41444061 @0x1848A4 ('AD\`a'), 0x6125233F @0x1848A8, 0x41414141 @0x1848AC ('AAAA'), 0x23232323 @0x1848B0 ('####'), 0x70212121 @0x1848CC, 0x20202020 @0x1848D0 (four spaces). REFUTED as a string table: these are NOT NUL-delimited and form no readable words -- they are isolated 4-byte words embedded mid-bitmap within the surrounding 0x02-fill and 0x78 markers (e.g. immediately preceded by 0x29634513 @0x1848B4 and followed by 0x14211741 @0x1848B8). Classified data_ (packed bytes that happen to be printable), NOT rodata_. Long 0x02020202 fill spans 0x184860..0x184918, 0x1849D8..0x184A18, 0x184AD0..0x184D20, 0x184D44..0x184DA0, 0x184E3C..0x184EA0, 0x184ABC..end-of-part fills. HYPOTHESIS: packed art/tile/glyph data; not parsed.

Trailing tail of the packed blob: almost entirely 0x02020202 zero-like filler (e.g. continuous run 0x185030..0x1850A4 and 0x1850B0..0x185128) with only sparse short active runs -- 0x02027877 @0x185024(boundary), 0x1E205959 @0x185028, 0x1F787878 @0x18502C, 0x741F7878 @0x1850A8, 0x78020202 @0x1850AC, 0x78780202 @0x185128.
